Subject: Staging rollback blocker — request for temporary trial padding

Hi Jonas,

Quick note from the ops desk — during a weekend schema migration in our staging environment we hit a regression in the SignalGrid -> Redwood connector that caused multiple pipelines to rollback and fail the adapter handshake. Our engineers traced it to a change in how the staging adapter handles streaming keepalive frames; the result is that we cannot finish our end-to-end tests and the demo window next week is now at risk.

We pulled logs and put a snapshot here: staging_logs.tar.gz (attached). The immediate asks:
- Can Redwood grant a 2-week extension to our trial window so we can finish validation?
- Can you provision an additional 50k sandbox token credit in the SignalGrid sandbox for us to run the repeatable test matrix?

We also need a copy of your SOC 2 summary and the mutual action plan template so we can get procurement moving in parallel. I uploaded an initial MPA draft to the SignalGrid Drive folder and will share an editable link once David and I align.

I know this is last-minute — appreciate any fast-track assistance you can provide. If useful we can spin up a brief war room with your eng and our platform team this afternoon.

Thanks,
Priya Shah
VP Platform, SignalGrid
priya@signalgrid.com

We ran the repro steps again and included a short summary below (will attach the runbook to the Drive link):

- Steps to reproduce: run the adapter init with payload X (see Drive/runbook.md), send 100 parallel streams, observe keepalive disconnect at ~7s
- Expected: stable handshake and KV commit across streams
- Observed: intermittent rollback + adapter restart, trace shows keepalive malformed frame at the border router

Drive MPA: https://drive.google.com/fake-folder/signalgrid-mpa (I gave edit to marissa.cole@redwood.com)
